aboutPageTitle: About VocalWitness • Truth • Evidence • Public Square
aboutSubtitle: Your Voice. Your Truth. Shared with Integrity.
missionPara1: For this era of deepfakes, misinformation, and centralized control, VocalWitness dey restore the public square. We believe truth no be something wey algorithm or gatekeeper dictate — e dey evidenced, witnessed, and verified by the people.
missionPara2: We dey empower every citizen to share raw testimonies, forensic media, and lived experiences with cryptographic integrity tools, while we dey protect privacy and resist manipulation.
forensicIntegrityDesc: Photos and voice recordings dey receive cryptographic hashing. Advanced verification (including Zero-Knowledge proofs wey dey development) dey help establish authenticity without revealing your identity.
privacyFirstDesc: Your identity remain protected. We dey use phone verification, reputation systems, and privacy-preserving technology so you fit speak boldly while you dey safe.
communityStewardshipDesc: No single entity control the narrative. Trust dey earn through honest participation. Verified Witnesses and reputation mechanics dey reward integrity.
communitySupportedDesc: Fully funded by voluntary sponsorships and willing donations from people wey believe for healthier information ecosystem. No paywalls. No premium features locked behind payments.
trustStep1Desc: Start as Citizen and earn higher trust levels through phone verification and consistent honest contributions. True Witness mode dey offer the strongest cryptographic guarantees.
trustStep2Desc: All media dey timestamp and hash. The Evidence Ledger dey preserve permanent, verifiable records of wetin dem share.
trustStep3Desc: We dey function strictly as neutral public square and distribution medium. We no dey edit, boost, or suppress content except to enforce basic safety and legal requirements.
aboutQuote: "For the age of noise, the clearest voice be the one wey fit prove say e never alter."
footerCopyright: © 2026 VocalWitness • Built for Truth • Evidence • Public Square
privacyIntro: For VocalWitness, we believe truth no suppose require say you sacrifice privacy. We dey committed to minimize data collection while we maintain the integrity of the public square.
privacySection1Text: We dey use privacy-preserving technologies (including Zero-Knowledge proofs where available) so you fit participate meaningfully while you protect your identity. We no dey sell user data. We no dey engage for surveillance advertising.
privacyNotCollect1: Government-issued IDs, passports, or biometric data
privacyNotCollect3: Your full social graph or personal contact list
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Email or phone number (for authentication), chosen username, and basic profile data wey you provide.
privacyContentDesc: Testimonies, photos, voice recordings, and associated metadata (e.g., timestamps, cryptographic hashes).
privacyVerificationDesc: Phone verification status and Zero-Knowledge proofs (where dem implement am). We no dey store the underlying private data.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Anonymous usage statistics, IP addresses (temporarily for security), and device information for spam/abuse prevention.
privacyUse1: To provide, maintain, and improve the platform
privacyUse2: To enable trust features (phone verification, ZK proofs, reputation)
privacyUse3: To enforce our Terms of Service and Safety Guidelines
privacyUse4: To respond to legal requests when law require am
privacySection5Text: You fit delete your account anytime, wey go remove your profile and unpublished content. But content wey dem already publish to the Public Square become part of the permanent record (like public speech) and e no fit erase fully.
privacySection6Text: Where dem implement am, ZK proofs allow us to verify say user meet certain criteria (e.g., be human, reach trust threshold) without storing or revealing sensitive personal information.
privacySection7Text: We dey use Firebase (Google) for authentication, database, and storage. Your data dey protected under their security standards. We no dey share personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacyImportant: Important: Public testimonies dey visible to everybody. We strongly recommend say you never post highly sensitive personal information wey fit compromise your safety.
termsIntro: Welcome to VocalWitness — citizen-powered public square for truth, evidence, and testimony. By using our platform, you agree to these Terms of Service.
termsSection1Text: By accessing or using VocalWitness, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms. If you no agree, you must not use the platform.
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness dey operate as un-manipulated distribution medium — public square where citizens fit share testimonies and evidence. We no be publisher, we no endorse content, and we no act as court of law.
termsSection3Intro: We dey use layered trust model to strengthen the quality of discourse:
termsTier1: Citizen Talk — Open to all users (basic signup).
termsTier3: True Witness — Highest tier, earned through consistent participation and advanced verification (including Zero-Knowledge proofs where dem implement am).
termsTierNote: Higher tiers unlock greater responsibilities and capabilities (e.g., group creation, higher visibility).
termsConduct1: You solely responsible for all content wey you post.
termsConduct2: You must share content wey you genuinely believe be true and act for good faith.
termsConduct3: You must not post illegal, defamatory, harassing, violent, hateful, or sexually exploitative content.
termsConduct4: You must not manipulate evidence or impersonate others.
termsSection5Text: You retain full ownership of your content. By posting on VocalWitness, you grant us worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, perpetual license to host, display, distribute, and archive your content on the platform and its mirrors.
termsSection6Text: Users fit create or join Groups and personal networks subject to their trust tier. Group creators and moderators responsible for enforcing community standards within their spaces. VocalWitness reserve the right to intervene for cases of serious violations.
termsSection7Text: VocalWitness dey sustain entirely through voluntary community donations, transparent support funds, and direct non-custodial cryptographic contributions. Donations no dey refundable and dem no grant special governance privileges or ownership over the platform.
termsSection8Text: VocalWitness and its maintainers disclaim liability for user-generated content, network disruptions, or external cryptographic verification failures.
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Once dem write record to the Forensic Ledger or the audit log, the application and database rules make am impossible for any user (or ordinary operator) to edit or delete am.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Firestore security rules explicitly forbid update and delete on the ledger collections.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: Client-side SHA-256 hashing of media and content.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: Hash-chaining of audit entries (each entry contain the cryptographic hash of the previous one).
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Important clarification: This be application-level immutability. E no be full public blockchain. The data dey live for Firebase / Google Cloud. The rules and cryptography make silent changes extremely difficult, but the ultimate trust still rest on the operator’s honesty and the cloud provider’s integrity.
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Planned optional strengthening (Batch 1 item 3): periodic cryptographic hashes of the ledger fit export and pin to IPFS and/or lightly anchor on public chain (Polygon or Base). This no yet active.
